fix: script/build_and_run.sh now terminates stale repo launch.py engines before app relaunch. EngineManager now cleans stale repo launch.py engines during startup and calls stop() in deinit for graceful exits.
method: Spawned a dummy Python sleeper whose argv contained this repo ExploitBotEngine/launch.py, ran script/build_and_run.sh --verify, confirmed launcher cleanup killed the dummy and no engine ports 8100-8110 remained listening. No model was loaded.
rootCause: Repeated dev relaunches killed only the Swift ExploitBot process. If the app was killed before EngineManager.stop() ran, Python model engines launched through ExploitBotEngine/launch.py could survive as orphaned processes, keep ports 8100+, and retain model RAM. Subsequent app launches selected the next free port and could load additional models.
